prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” AI video ad maker — the right one depends on what kind of ad you want, your budget, and how much control you need. Below are top picks by use case plus a quick recommendation to help you choose.

Quick recommendation
- If you want one versatile, easy tool for fast social ads and templates: Canva (video) is the easiest all‑around choice.
- If you need realistic AI presenters/talking‑head ads: Synthesia or HeyGen.
- If you’re repurposing long content into short ads: Pictory or Descript/Opus Clip.
- If you want more creative generative visuals or advanced editing: Runway.

Best tools by use case
- AI presenters / talking‑head ads
  - Synthesia: realistic avatar presenters, many languages, script→video workflow. Great when you need on‑camera talent without filming.
  - HeyGen (Movio/Elai.io are similar): comparable features, some differences in avatar style or pricing.

- Template-driven social ads / quick creatives
  - Canva (Video): huge template library, easy resizing for different platforms, basic AI features (text-to-video, Magic Write), collaboration.
  - InVideo / FlexClip / Promo.com: lots of ad templates, stock media, fast exports.

- Repurposing longform to short ads
  - Pictory: auto-summarize long videos/articles into short clips with captions.
  - Descript + Opus Clip: fine control over editing, automatic highlights and captioning.

- Advanced generative visuals / creative VFX
  - Runway: powerful generative models, background removal, green-screen replacement, creative tools for standout visuals.
  - Kaiber / Luma AI: for more experimental visual generation.

- Full production with strong voiceovers
  - Synthesia/Elai + ElevenLabs (for natural TTS) combinations are common; use one for visuals and a TTS engine if you need very natural voices.

What to consider when choosing
- Ad type: talking‑head vs animated vs live‑action repurpose.
- Output formats: square, vertical, landscape and auto‑resize for different platforms.
- Languages & voices: do you need multilingual audio?
- Speed & scale: batch creation / A/B variants and templates.
- Budget: free tiers exist, but professional use often needs paid plans.
- Rights & stock: licensing for stock footage and music.

How I’d help you pick
Tell me: What kind of ad do you want (talking head, animated, repurposed clips), which platforms (Facebook/Instagram/TikTok/YouTube), and your budget (free/low/agency)? I’ll recommend 2–3 specific tools and a workflow.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
